events.summary: The concrete delivery is unconfirmed. Before our coordination meeting, check the schedule, speak to Sam and contact Morgan. Update the delivery card and record an issue with evidence, an owner and a next check. Bring me a recommendation, not an order. You may gather information and escalate; only I can approve procurement.
Inspected Foundation delivery schedule: delivery → foundations → framing; baseline Day 12, wait Day 13 (+400), alternate Day 12 (+2,000).
Asked Sam for evidence. Two crews are waiting. No concrete means no foundations, and framing depends on foundations. If it misses 10:30, we can resequence preparatory work.
Pressed Sam for an unsupported shortcut. Asking us to guarantee the date will not move a truck. Check the supplier, and tell us what is confirmed.
Asked Morgan for evidence. A replacement has a 70% chance of reaching you around 10:30. An alternate costs 2,000 extra credits and needs your PM’s approval. Please check back at 10:30.
Asked Taylor for evidence. I can check an approved alternate at 10:30. Alex must approve the extra cost first. You may recommend a review, but cannot waive it.
Updated concrete delivery to blocked; owner Morgan, due Day 1, blocker “Truck fault; no receipt”, sources schedule, supplier.
Recorded “Concrete delivery not confirmed”: high severity, foundation impact, owner Sam, Day 1 check 10:30, estimate; sources schedule, lead, supplier.
Recorded alternative comparison: wait Day 13 / +400 credits; alternate Day 12 / +2000 credits.
Recommended Wait with a contingency to Alex; estimate, foundation impact, verify at 10:30.
Explained that Morgan’s 70% estimate is not confirmation; Alex owns procurement approval and the 10:30 check will verify delivery.
Alex approved waiting with crew contingency and a 10:30 verification; no alternate expenditure is committed.
Replacement arrived and passed acceptance at 10:30, after the morning pour slot. The crew contingency limited the foundation forecast to Day 13; standby cost +400.
Completed CONST-I01; earned 100 XP. Role remains Junior PM Intern; promotion requires further mission evidence and a challenge.
